about: Finnish National Library's Digi service (digitized newspapers, journals, books, maps, music and more). The CLI searches full text and metadata, reads issue (binding) details and page OCR text, browses serial titles by year, searches user-made clippings, lists collections, and harvests OAI-PMH metadata.

commands.summary: Full-text and metadata search over digitized materials. Returns matching pages (bindings) with OCR highlights.

params.name: query
params.description: Search terms. Supports Digi query syntax (quotes, AND/OR, wildcards).

params.name: format
params.description: Material type to search. Sent as a single-element formats array. An empty value can cause a server error, so it defaults to NEWSPAPER.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sort order. DATE is oldest first and DATE_DESC is newest first.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Earliest publication date, ISO format, e.g. 1900-01-01

params.name: endDate
params.description: Latest publication date, ISO format, e.g. 1939-12-31

params.name: fuzzy
params.description: Fuzzy matching, which tolerates OCR errors

params.name: requireAllKeywords
params.description: true means all terms must match (AND); false means any term (OR)

params.name: queryTargetsMetadata
params.description: Also search metadata such as titles and authors

commands.summary: Search component parts (articles or sections within issues) by keyword. Returns article titles with their binding and page.

params.name: format
params.description: Material type to search. Sent as a single-element formats array. An empty value causes a server error, so it defaults to NEWSPAPER.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Earliest publication date, ISO format, e.g. 1900-01-01

params.name: endDate
params.description: Latest publication date, ISO format, e.g. 1939-12-31

commands.summary: Get details of one issue or volume (binding): title, date, ISSN, page list with image URLs, PDF link and citation info.
Get the OCR text blocks of one page of a binding.

params.name: oldOcr
params.description: Return the original OCR instead of the re-OCR version

commands.summary: Get the positions (bounding boxes) of a search term on one page of a binding.

params.name: term
params.description: Term to locate, as in search result 'terms'

commands.summary: List the component parts (articles or sections) that appear on a given page of a binding.
Get descriptive metadata for a serial title by ISSN: publishing period, places, supplements, political orientation, predecessors and successors.

params.name: issn
params.description: ISSN or local title id (publicationId), e.g. 1457-4314 or fk14195

commands.summary: List the years for which a serial title (newspaper or journal) has digitized issues.
List all digitized issues of a serial title for one year, with binding ids and dates.
List all digitized newspaper and journal titles, with ISSN or id, years, languages, places and coverage. The response is large.
Search user-made clippings (cut-out articles with category, subject and keywords) by keyword and date.
Get one user clipping (article) by id: title, text, keywords and source binding.
List clipping categories and subjects (ids and Finnish names) used to classify clippings.
Look up keywords that users have assigned to clippings.

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword prefix or text to match

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of values to return

commands.summary: Look up values for search filters: titles, collections, publishers, publishing places, tags or authors.

params.name: type
params.description: Which filter dimension to look up

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of values to return

commands.summary: Show, per material type, the date up to which material is freely viewable. Newer material is restricted for anonymous users.
List the collection tree (collection ids and names, nested by category).
Get a collection's name, HTML description and material types.
Harvest Dublin Core metadata records for a collection through the public OAI-PMH interface (ListRecords).

params.name: set
params.description: OAI set spec: col-{collectionId}, e.g. col-742
